Expected Behaviour after Mouse Click:
Auto merging of mid-band tracks shall be
disabled at ES Processor. This shall be the
default state.

GUI to set ‘Forbidden Frequency Bands’ shall
be displayed to user. If set successfully, the
same shall be applied in ‘Emitter Presentation
Windows’.

GUI to remove (reset) ‘Forbidden Frequency
Bands’ shall be displayed to user. If set
successfully, the same shall be applied in
‘Emitter Presentation Windows’. By default, no
forbidden frequency bands shall be enforced.

GUI to set ‘Forbidden Sectors’ shall be
displayed to user. If set successfully, the same
shall be applied in ‘Emitter Presentation
Windows’.

GUI to remove (reset) ‘Forbidden Sectors’
shall be displayed to user. If set successfully,
the same shall be applied in ‘Emitter
Presentation Windows’. By default, no
forbidden sectors shall be enforced.

Description:
Add Track to
Temporary Emitter
Library
Expected Behaviour after Mouse Click:
‘Temporary Emitter Library’ GUI shall be
displayed to user for adding selected track to
the library.

SCD ‘System Recording’ shall be started, if not
started already. By default, recording shall be
started.
SCD ‘System Recording’ shall be stopped, if
already started.

This shall be a toggling button. By default, ‘Link
& Self-Test Status’ GUI shall be hidden
whenever SCD Main Window is activated.
